title: RELATED cannot be used across a many-to-many cardinality relationship

expected.error: Target[Category] -> Product[Category] has many-to-many cardinality, so it is a limited relationship: RELATED cannot fetch Product[Color]

source.quote: The RELATED DAX function can't be used to retrieve the "one" side column values
source.supports: RELATED is not available across a limited relationship

source.quote: The RELATED function cannot be used to fetch a column across a limited relationship
The relationship uses a many-to-many cardinality type (even if one or both columns contain unique values)
source.supports: a many-to-many cardinality relationship is limited
